Verso upper left (printed label in black ink on backing board): 12. In the Patio II. 1948. 
 
Verso upper left (printed gallery label in black ink on backing board): ARTIST: GEORGIA O'KEEFFE NO. 271 // TITLE IN THE PATIO II Date 1948 // MEDIUM Oil SIze 30x18 S.P. // THE DOWNTOWN GALLERY 32 E. 51st St., New York 
 
Verso upper left (printed and handwritten exhibition label in black ink on backing board): Box 1 # 3 // REGISTRATION NUMBER // O'Keeffe // ARTIST // SUBJECT // Mrs. Everett Jones // McNAY ART INSTITUTE // SAN ANTONIO, TEVerso upper left (printed and hand written exhibition label in black ink on backing board): McNAY ART INSTITUTE // SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS // EXHIBITION "Georgia O'Keeffe" // DATE 24 Oct. - 30 Nov. 75 // NUMBER 13 // Bishop & Mrs Jones 
 
Verso upper left (printed exhibition label in black ink on backing board): GEORGIA O'KEEFFE // American, Born 1887 // "In the Patio II", 1948 // Oil on canvas // Lent from a private collection 
 
Verso upper left (printed exhibition label in black ink on backing board): McMichael // CANADIAN ART // COLLECTION // D'ART CANADIEN // Exhibition: Carr, O'Keeffe, Kahlo: Places of Their Own // Exhibition Number: 46 // Crate number: 32 // Artist: Georgia O'Keeffe // Title & Date: In the Patio II 1948 // Owner: Museum of New Mexico, Museum of Fine Arts 
 
Verso upper left (printed exhibition label in black ink on backing board): Kunsthaus Zurich, Heimplatz 1, 8001 Zurich // Ausstellung Georgia O'Keeffe, 24.10.2003 - 1.2.2004 // Kat.Nr.57 // Georgia O'Keeffe // In the Patio II, 1948 // Ol auf Leinwand // 45.7 x 76.2 cm // Museum of Fine Arts, Museum of New Mexico, Santa Fe 
(Source: New Mexico Museum of Art, 2025)

credit_line: Collection of the New Mexico Museum of Art. Bequest of Helen Miller Jones, 1986 (1986.137.19)
description: A thin strip of beige ground runs across the bottom of the composition. Above this is a light brown wall with a dark brown door hovering at its center. At the top of the canvas is a rectangle of pale blue sky.
